features.title: Everything you need for meaningful conversations

items.title: Guided conversation flow
items.description: A structured framework guides you through every phase of the conversation – before, during and after. You always know what to focus on and how to guide the dialogue without having to improvise. This creates consistency and confidence in every encounter.

items.title: Automatic transcription
items.description: Conversations are recorded and transcribed in real time while everything is captured precisely in the background. You no longer have to divide your attention between listening and taking notes. This allows you to remain truly present with the child.

items.title: Smart prompts & question suggestions
items.description: During the conversation, the app provides relevant prompts and empowering questions developed by certified learning coaches and learning therapists. This helps you keep the thread, go deeper from the very beginning and lead conversations that move people and create real change.

items.title: AI-generated summaries
items.description: After each conversation, the app automatically creates a clear and structured summary. It highlights strengths, key discussion points and agreed next steps. What used to take a lot of time can now be completed in just a few minutes.

items.title: Parent email generator
items.description: After each conversation, a structured and supportive email to the parents is ready. It contains key insights, strengths and agreed goals – automatically in the parents' preferred language. The app creates a draft that the teacher reviews, supplements and consciously approves. This keeps parents informed and involved while responsibility and control clearly remain with the teacher.

items.title: WOOP goal generator
items.description: The integrated WOOP model helps turn goals into concrete, actionable plans. Students define what they want to achieve, recognize possible obstacles and decide how to respond to them. This makes goals realistic, measurable and much more likely to be put into practice.

items.title: Student profiles & development history
items.description: Every student has a dynamic profile that makes strengths, competencies and their level of independence visible. You can track development over time and identify patterns across different areas. This creates a complete and meaningful picture of each student's development.

descriptions.text: Scientifically grounded and developed for everyday school life

Eisberg draws, among other things, on John Hattie's research on Visible Learning. His comprehensive synthesis of more than 800 meta-analyses shows that a strong relationship between teacher and student has a significant influence on learning. The original analysis reports an effect size of d = 0.72. Later overviews cite d = 0.52. Both values are above Hattie's benchmark of d = 0.40. Visible Learning, updated overview of effect sizes

For goal setting, Eisberg draws on Professor Gabriele Oettingen's scientifically grounded WOOP method. WOOP stands for Wish, Outcome, Obstacle and Plan. Students formulate a wish, imagine the desired outcome, identify an internal obstacle and develop a concrete if-then plan for dealing with it. This means it goes beyond positive thinking: a wish becomes an actionable next step. WOOP – scientific background

The five Eisberg Levels make development and increasing independence visible. They range from Deep Sea, with close support, to Summit, where students demonstrate a competency independently. Each competency is considered individually because development does not progress equally in all areas. This allows you to make visible what students are already doing well, where they need support and what potential they may not yet recognize in themselves.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.description: Everything you need to know about Eisberg and how it works

questions.question: What is Eisberg?
questions.answer: Eisberg is a tool that helps teachers lead structured and meaningful learning and coaching conversations. It supports every step of the process – from preparation through the conversation itself to follow-up and communication with parents.

questions.question: Who is Eisberg for?
questions.answer: Eisberg was primarily developed for teachers and learning support professionals who work with school-age students. It is also valuable for schools and educational organizations that want to improve the quality of learning and coaching conversations.

questions.question: How does Eisberg work?
questions.answer: Eisberg supports you through three phases: before, during and after the conversation. It helps you prepare, supports you with prompts during the conversation and then automatically creates summaries and communication for parents.

questions.question: Do I need to prepare before every conversation?
questions.answer: Preparation is minimal. Before each conversation, you get a quick overview of previous conversations, notes and development, so you can be prepared and get started within minutes.

questions.question: Does Eisberg replace my way of teaching?
questions.answer: No. Eisberg strengthens your existing approach by giving you structure and support. You remain in charge of the conversation – the app simply helps you make it more effective.

questions.question: Is the conversation recorded?
questions.answer: Yes, conversations are recorded and transcribed to support documentation. Audio data is processed securely and handled according to strict data protection standards.

questions.question: Is Eisberg GDPR-compliant?
questions.answer: Yes. Eisberg is fully GDPR-compliant. Audio is deleted immediately after transcription (zero retention), and no student data is used for AI training. All data is stored on EU servers.

questions.question: Can parents access the app?
questions.answer: No, the app is designed for teachers. However, parents receive clear and structured summaries after each conversation so that they remain informed and involved.

questions.question: Can I use Eisberg in different languages?
questions.answer: Yes. Eisberg supports multilingual communication, especially when creating parent emails. This makes it easier to involve families with different language backgrounds.

questions.question: How does the free trial work?
questions.answer: You can start using Eisberg immediately without a credit card. During the trial, you have access to the full range of features so you can experience the complete process.

questions.question: What do I get with a license?
questions.answer: A license gives you access to unlimited conversations, student profiles, automatic summaries, parent communication as well as additional educational content and support.

questions.question: Do I need school approval to use Eisberg?
questions.answer: Yes. Since Eisberg processes sensitive data, its use should be discussed with the school in advance and properly regulated from a data protection perspective. This generally requires a data processing agreement and parental consent. We provide the necessary templates and appropriate correspondence.

questions.question: How long does it take to get started?
questions.answer: Getting started is quick. Once setup and the required approvals are complete, you can begin your first learning and coaching conversation right away. You will find our onboarding dates in the calendar and can simply choose the appointment that suits you best.

questions.question: Does it make my everyday work more time-consuming?
questions.answer: No – the goal is exactly the opposite. Eisberg reduces administrative work and simplifies documentation so that you can focus more strongly on the conversation itself.

questions.question: What makes Eisberg different from other tools?
questions.answer: Eisberg is not simply a documentation tool. It combines structured conversation guidance, real-time support and automatic follow-up to improve the quality of conversations – not just to record them.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy of the Eisberg App
privacy.content:
Last updated: August 2026

1. What is this Privacy Policy about?

Eisberg is an app for learning and coaching conversations at school. It supports teachers and specialist staff in preparing, conducting and summarizing conversations with students.

The app helps identify strengths, ask appropriate questions, and record goals, obstacles and next steps. With the prior consent of the parents or the authorized person, a conversation can be recorded. Eisberg creates a written summary from the recording. The audio file is then automatically and permanently deleted.

This Privacy Policy explains which personal data is processed when using Eisberg, why we need this data, who can access it and what rights data subjects have.

2. Who provides Eisberg?

Eisberg is provided by:

Pädagogik+ GmbH

Schüracherstrasse 45

8700 Küsnacht

Switzerland

Email: info@paedagogik-plus.com

www.pädagogik-plus.com

www.eisberg-coaching.com

For questions about data protection, you can contact:

Branka Rezan, Owner

Email: branka.rezan@paedagogik-plus.com

3. Who is responsible for data processing?

If a public or private school uses Eisberg, the respective school or responsible school authority generally remains responsible for processing school-related personal data.

Pädagogik+ GmbH processes the data in accordance with the agreed instructions.

To the extent that Pädagogik+ GmbH processes data under its own responsibility for operating the app, managing user accounts, billing, security or support, Pädagogik+ GmbH is responsible for this processing.

4. Who is Eisberg intended for?

Eisberg is intended for:

- Teachers
- Special education teachers
- School social workers
- School-based specialists
- Coaches and other authorized support persons
- Schools and school authorities
- Students as part of a supported conversation

Students do not use Eisberg without the supervision of an authorized adult.

5. What personal data is processed?

Depending on how the app is used, the following personal data may be processed:

Data of teachers and specialist staff

- First and last name
- Email address
- School and role
- User account and access permissions
- Login information
- Selected settings
- Information about licenses and subscriptions
- Support requests and communications
- Technical usage data and security logs

Data of students

- First and last name, i.e. assigned identifiers
- Class or learning group
- Conversation date
- Conversation content
- Strengths, interests and resources
- Academic and personal challenges
- Goals, obstacles and next steps
- Written conversation summaries
- Notes from authorized teachers and specialist staff
- Information about consent that has been granted or refused
- Audio data during temporary processing

Learning and coaching conversations may involve sensitive personal data. This may include information about health, well-being, family situations, special educational measures or social difficulties. The responsible teacher or specialist carefully determines, in accordance with the principle of proportionality, which information is necessary for the specific conversation and educational support.

6. For what purposes is the data processed?

The data is processed in particular for the following purposes:

- Preparation of learning and coaching conversations
- Conducting and structuring conversations
- Identifying strengths, resources and challenges
- Developing goals and next steps
- Creating a written conversation summary
- Documenting agreed goals and measures
- Preparing for further conversations
- Managing user accounts and access rights
- Providing, securing and improving the conversations
- Handling support requests
- Managing licenses, contracts and billing
- Fulfilling contractual obligations

Personal data is not used for advertising. Conversation content is not sold and is not disclosed to third parties for advertising purposes.

Conversation content is not used to automatically assess or grade students or to make decisions about educational measures.

7. How does audio recording work?

An audio recording is made only if the required consent has been given in advance.

Before recording begins, the people present are informed that the conversation will be recorded. Recording may only begin once all required consents have been obtained.

The audio file is processed exclusively to create a written summary of the conversation. It is not permanently stored in the app.

After the summary has been created, the audio file is automatically and permanently deleted. It can then no longer be accessed or restored by either the school or Pädagogik+ GmbH.

If a transcript is temporarily created during processing, it is also permanently deleted after the summary has been created.

Only the approved conversation summary and the recorded goals and next steps are stored permanently.

8. Is consent voluntary?

Consent to audio recording is voluntary.

If consent is not given, the learning or coaching conversation takes place without audio recording and without an automatic summary. The student does not suffer any educational disadvantage as a result.

Consent that has been given can be withdrawn at any time for future conversations. The lawfulness of processing that has already been completed is not affected by the withdrawal.

The withdrawal can be submitted to the school or via the following contact address:

branka.rezan@paedagogik-plus.com

If a student has sufficient capacity to make decisions based on their age and personal development, their wishes must also be appropriately taken into account. A recording should not be made against the student's clearly expressed wishes.

9. What is the legal basis for processing the data?

Public schools process personal data on the basis of the applicable cantonal data protection law and the relevant school regulations.

Pädagogik+ GmbH is subject in particular to the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection.

Audio recording is based on prior consent from the authorized persons. Consent to record a non-public conversation must be obtained before recording begins.

10. Who has access to the data?

Within the school, only authorized teachers and specialist staff who support the student and need the information for their duties receive access.

Access rights are assigned by the school and should be reviewed regularly.

Employees of Pädagogik+ GmbH only receive access when this is necessary for technical operation, security or handling a support request. They are required to maintain confidentiality.

Parents do not automatically receive access to the teacher's user account. Statutory rights to information, access and inspection remain unaffected.

11. Is data shared with external service providers?

Carefully selected technical service providers may be used to operate Eisberg, for example for:

- Hosting and data storage
- Creating transcripts and summaries
- Sending emails
- User authentication
- Error analysis and technical security
- Payment processing
- Support

These service providers may process personal data only to the agreed extent and for the specified purposes. They are contractually required to maintain confidentiality, ensure data security and delete data.

Eisberg uses the following key service providers:

Service provider:

DigitalOcean, LLC

Operation and storage of the app

Country: Netherlands (Amsterdam data center); provider based in the USA

OpenAI Ireland Ltd. / OpenAI, L.L.C.

Temporary conversion of the audio file into text

Country: Ireland (EU) / USA

Anthropic PBC (Claude)

Creation of the conversation summary

Country: USA

Brevo (Sendinblue SAS)

Sending technical messages

Country: France (EU)

Pädagogik-Plus GmbH

Payment processing

Country: Switzerland

Google Ireland Ltd. / Google LLC

Hosting of the parent questionnaire (Google Forms), sending push notifications

Country: Ireland (EU) / USA

An up-to-date list of the service providers used can be requested via branka.rezan@paedagogik-plus.com.

12. Is data transferred abroad?

Personal data is generally stored and processed in the EU.

If a service provider processes data in a country that does not provide data protection comparable to that of Switzerland or the EU, appropriate safeguards are implemented. These include, in particular, recognized standard contractual clauses and additional technical and organizational safeguards.

Audio recordings and conversation content are processed only in the countries named in this Privacy Policy.

Before publication, this section must specify exactly whether audio recordings or summaries are processed outside Switzerland and the EU.

13. Is the data used to train artificial intelligence?

Audio recordings, transcripts, conversation summaries and other school-related personal data may not be used by Pädagogik+ GmbH or the service providers used by it to train their own or third-party artificial intelligence models.

They are also not used to create advertising profiles or for personalized advertising.

14. How long is the data stored?

Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary for the respective purpose or as long as there is a legal obligation to retain it.

The school is responsible for determining the applicable retention periods and having school-related data that is no longer required deleted.

When a student leaves the school or a teacher leaves their position, access rights are reviewed and adjusted.

15. How is the data protected?

Pädagogik+ GmbH and the responsible school implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data.

These include, in particular:

- Encrypted data transmission
- Encryption of stored data
- Personal user accounts
- Secure passwords and authentication procedures
- Role-based access rights
- Logging of security-relevant activities
- Regular security checks
- Secure backups
- Contractual obligations for service providers
- Training and confidentiality obligations for authorized employees
- Procedures for detecting and handling data protection incidents

Despite careful security measures, absolute security cannot be guaranteed when processing data digitally.

16. What rights do data subjects have?

Under applicable law, data subjects have, in particular, the right to:

- Request information about their processed personal data
- Have inaccurate data corrected
- Request the deletion of unlawfully processed or no longer required data
- Have unlawful processing prohibited
- Withdraw consent for the future
- Contact the competent data protection supervisory authority

The right of access relates to personal data that is still available at the time of the request. If an audio file has already been permanently deleted, a copy of the recording can no longer be provided. However, information can still be requested about existing summaries and other stored personal data.

The rights of minors are exercised depending on their age and capacity to make decisions, either by the minors themselves or by their legal representative.

Requests concerning school-related data should generally be addressed to the responsible school:

Requests concerning Pädagogik+ GmbH can be sent to:

branka.rezan@paedagogik-plus.com

An appropriate proof of identity may be required before information is provided.

17. Are automated decisions made?

Eisberg does not make decisions about students based solely on automated processing.

The summary created by Eisberg is a support tool for teachers and specialist staff. It does not replace educational or professional assessment. The responsible teacher must review the summary and can correct or supplement it.
